demo.title: cryptoslip-payouts.sh
demo.code:
# Mode A: Bounded PocketSlip MCP server (zero wallet private key handed to the agent)
# Rotates the inbound slip key on boot at 0% fee and enforces BoundedAgentPolicy spend caps
claude mcp add cryptoslip \
  -e CRYPTOSLIP_URL="<YOUR_SLIP_URL>" \
  -e CRYPTOSLIP_MAX_PER_CALL_USD="0.50" \
  -e CRYPTOSLIP_MAX_DAILY_USD="5.00" \
  -- npx -y @cryptoslip/mcp

# Mode B: Reclaim an unclaimed revocable DM slip at 0% fee via Bankr Wallet API on Base (8453)
# calldata for refundSlip(uint256) on CryptoSlipVaultV32 (0x3f80aa68Fb4834d6E119EE1cf932C14419Cf63EB)
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.bankr.bot/wallet/submit" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $BANKR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "transaction": {
      "to": "0x3f80aa68Fb4834d6E119EE1cf932C14419Cf63EB",
      "chainId": 8453,
      "value": "0",
      "data": "<ENCODED_REFUND_SLIP_CALLDATA>"
    },
    "description": "Reclaim unclaimed CryptoSLIP payout (0% fee)",
    "waitForConfirmation": true
  }'

setup: Install skill: `install the cryptoslip skill from https://github.com/BankrBot/skills/tree/main/cryptoslip`

For Bankr Wallet API batch minting/reclaims on Base (8453): enable Wallet API (`read-write`) and switch on arbitrary contract calls in Bankr security settings while signing EIP-712 `MintPermit` payloads

For isolated sub-agent spending without exposing `BANKR_API_KEY`: mint a bounded USDC/ETH/cbBTC/NARA slip at `https://slip.naraprotocol.io` and run `CRYPTOSLIP_URL="<YOUR_SLIP_URL>" npx -y @cryptoslip/mcp`
Optional TypeScript SDK for custom pipelines and HTTP 402 servers: `npm install @cryptoslip/sdk viem`
